en.description:
#SoloCamping #QandA #CampingYouTuber



*This video contains paid promotion by Crocs

💛Crocs, your essential camping item!! I went to the "DIY Station" event celebrating the first anniversary of the "ICON Store" at Shinsegae Department Store in Hanam, where I created my own personalized Crocs with fans!💛
